verdict.rationale: Aircall's homepage says SMS and messaging live in its platform, and that a shared inbox keeps every conversation visible for real-time team collaboration. It does not explicitly say inbound texts to the business number route into that shared inbox, and nothing shows per-message attribution of which teammate replied. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that inbound SMS to a business number lands in the shared inbox, evidence that the team can see who replied, in-depth first-party docs on the feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, texts to the business number land in a shared inbox where the team sees who replied

citations.quote: Calls, SMS, and messaging live in one platform
A shared inbox keeps every conversation visible, giving your team the ability to collaborate in real time and step in without losing context.
